# References and external docs {#references}

Curated **official** links for standards, install guides, and APIs cited in this tutorial. Chapters point here (or link inline) instead of duplicating install steps.

|---|---|

| `dataclasses` | [dataclasses](https://docs.python.org/3/library/dataclasses.html) |
| `typing` / type hints | [typing](https://docs.python.org/3/library/typing.html) |

| Dunder / data model | [Special method names](https://docs.python.org/3/reference/datamodel.html#special-method-names) |

### PEPs (style, packaging, typing)

| PEP | Title |
|---|---|
| [PEP 8](https://peps.python.org/pep-0008/) | Style Guide for Python Code |
| [PEP 257](https://peps.python.org/pep-0257/) | Docstring Conventions |
| [PEP 318](https://peps.python.org/pep-0318/) | Decorators for Functions and Methods |
| [PEP 484](https://peps.python.org/pep-0484/) | Type Hints |
| [PEP 517](https://peps.python.org/pep-0517/) | Build system (`pyproject.toml` hooks) |
| [PEP 518](https://peps.python.org/pep-0518/) | `pyproject.toml` as config file |
| [PEP 621](https://peps.python.org/pep-0621/) | Project metadata in `pyproject.toml` |
| [PEP 660](https://peps.python.org/pep-0660/) | Editable installs for pyproject builds |
| [PEP 420](https://peps.python.org/pep-0420/) | Implicit namespace packages (we use explicit `__init__.py`) |
